info.title: fabplane API
info.description: fabplane.com orgs, tokens, carts and inventory (v1). Initial snapshot written from the API contract; refreshed weekly from GET /v1/public/openapi.json.

post.summary: Create a personal API token (secret shown once)

get.summary: Orgs joinable via the caller's verified email domain

post.summary: Create (or upsert by externalId) an item; JSON or multipart with images

delete.summary: Delete an item and its images

post.summary: Upload an image (≤10 MiB, ≤10 per item)

get.summary: Items with no image that are not skipped

post.summary: Release a lease (retry) or mark skipped (not_found)
Put an item back in the queue (admin)

bearer.description: fpk_… personal API token or fpd_… device token
